13144-medieval-people.description: A book by Eileen Power. It is the idea that history is about dead people, or, worse still, about movements and conditions which seem but vaguely related to the labours and passions of flesh and blood, which has driven history from bookshelves where the historical novel still finds a welcome place.

arxiv-2012-06042.title: NEO Population, Velocity Bias, and Impact Risk from an ATLAS Analysis
arxiv-2012-06042.creator: A. N. Heinze, Larry Denneau, John L. Tonry, Steven J. Smartt, Nicolas Erasmus, Alan Fitzsimmons, James E. Robinson, Henry Weiland, Heather Flewelling, Brian Stalder, Armin Rest, David R. Young
arxiv-2012-06042.description: Abstract We estimate the total population of near-Earth objects (NEOs) in the Solar System, using an extensive, ‘Solar System to pixels’ fake-asteroid simulation to debias detections of real NEOs by the ATLAS survey. Down to absolute magnitudes H = 25 H=25 and 27.

arxiv-2201-10007.title: Evolutionary timeline of a modeled cell
arxiv-2201-10007.creator: Vrani Ibarra-Junquera, Diego Radillo-Ochoa, César A. Terrero-Escalante
arxiv-2201-10007.description: Abstract A theoretical study of cell evolution is presented here. By using a toolbox containing an intracellular catalytic reaction network model and a mutation-selection process, four distinct phases of self-organization were unveiled. First, the nutrients prevail as the central substrate of the chemical reactions. Second, the cell becomes a small-world .

arxiv-2206-05802.title: Self-critiquing models for assisting human evaluators
arxiv-2206-05802.creator: William Saunders, Catherine Yeh, Jeff WuSteven BillsLong OuyangJonathan WardJan LeikeOpenAI
arxiv-2206-05802.description: Abstract We fine-tune large language models to write natural language critiques (natural language critical comments) using behavioral cloning. On a topic-based summarization task, critiques written by our models help humans find flaws in summaries that they would have otherwise missed.

arxiv-2311-01858.title: Magnetic properties and spin dynamics in a spin-orbit driven J eff J_{\rm eff} = 1/2 triangular lattice antiferromagnet
arxiv-2311-01858.creator: J. Khatua, S. Bhattacharya, A. M. Strydom, A. Zorko, J. S. Lord, A. Ozarowski, E. Kermarrec, P. Khuntia
arxiv-2311-01858.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by J. Khatua, S. Bhattacharya, A. M. Strydom, A. Zorko, J. S. Lord, A. Ozarowski, E. Kermarrec, P. Khuntia. Frustration induced strong quantum fluctuations accompanied by spin-orbit coupling and crystal electric field can give rise to rich and diverse magnetic phenomena associated with unconventional low-energy excitations in rare-earth based quantum magnets.

arxiv-2402-18781.title: Conjectural Online Learning with First-order Beliefs in Asymmetric Information Stochastic Games
arxiv-2402-18781.creator: Tao Li, Kim Hammar, Rolf Stadler, Quanyan Zhu
arxiv-2402-18781.description: Abstract Asymmetric information stochastic games ( aisg s) arise in many complex socio-technical systems, such as cyber-physical systems and IT infrastructures. Existing computational methods for aisg s are primarily offline and can not adapt to equilibrium deviations. Further, current methods are limited to particular information structures to avoid belief hierarchies.

arxiv-2505-17412.title: Direct3D-S2: Gigascale 3D Generation Made Easy with Spatial Sparse Attention
arxiv-2505-17412.creator: Shuang Wu, Youtian Lin, Feihu Zhang, Yifei Zeng, Yikang Yang, Yajie Bao, Jiachen Qian, Siyu Zhu, Xun Cao, Philip Torr, Yao Yao
arxiv-2505-17412.description: Abstract Generating high-resolution 3D shapes using volumetric representations such as Signed Distance Functions (SDFs) presents substantial computational and memory challenges. We introduce Direct3D-S2, a scalable 3D generation framework based on sparse volumes that achieves superior output quality with dramatically reduced training costs.

arxiv-2511-22877.description: Abstract . We prove a local-global principle for representations of binary by quaternary quadratic forms. One of the main ingredients is a recent measure rigidity result of Einsiedler and Lindenstrauss for diagonalizable actions on quotients of products of SL 2 \mathrm{SL}_{2} ’s.

pmc-12468579.title: Cholinergic dysfunction in occupational manganese exposure
pmc-12468579.creator: T Noah Hutson, Susan Searles Nielsen, Natalie Senini, John O’Donnell, Hubert P Flores, Tamara Hershey, Joel S Perlmutter, Anil Kumar Soda, Stephen M Moerlein, Zhude Tu, Michael Kasper, Lianne Sheppard, Brad A Racette, Susan R Criswell
pmc-12468579.description: Background and objective:Excessive exposure to manganese (Mn) produces a clinical syndrome of parkinsonism and cognitive impairment. However, our understanding of the mechanisms of Mn neurotoxicity remains limited. This study aimed to evaluate the relationships between Mn exposure, cholinergic function, and cognitive impairment in exposed workers.

pmc-12617351.title: Prevalence, Molecular Profile and Antibiotic Resistance of Listeria Species in Retail Beef Products in North‐West Province, South Africa: A Cross‐Sectional Analysis
pmc-12617351.creator: Nduduzo C Mtshali, Nomakorinte Gcebe, Rebone Moerane, Abiodun A Adesiyun
pmc-12617351.description: This cross‐sectional study determined the occurrence, distribution, molecular characteristics and antibiograms of Listeria species recovered from beef and beef products retailed in the North‐West Province, South Africa. The study also investigated the factors associated with the contamination of these products by Listeria spp. and their characteristics.

pmc-12650628.title: Designing Biomimetic Learning Environments for Animal Welfare Education: A Gamified Approach
pmc-12650628.creator: Ebru Emsen, Bahadir Baran Odevci, Muzeyyen Kutluca Korkmaz, Fatma Alshamsi, Alyaziya Alkaabi, Xinhui Kang, Min Qu, Marc Weissburg
pmc-12650628.description: Animal welfare education requires pedagogical models that bridge conceptual knowledge with practice. This study presents GamifyWELL, a biomimetic, gamified learning environment for students, farmers, and veterinary technicians. Grounded in ecological principles of adaptation, diversification, and niche specialization, the design emulates how living systems evolve through feedback and cooperation.

pmc-12687901.title: Effects of Chronic Elevation in Plasma Membrane Cholesterol on the Function of Human Na+/Taurocholate Cotransporting Polypeptide (NTCP) and Organic Cation Transporter 1 (OCT1)
pmc-12687901.creator: Jessica Y. Idowu, Caylie McKimens, Bruno Hagenbuch
pmc-12687901.description: Background:We have previously demonstrated that the function and expression of the Na+/taurocholate cotransporting polypeptide (NTCP) and the organic cation transporter 1 (OCT1) are affected by increasing free or unesterified cholesterol in the plasma membrane by an acute incubation with cholesterol for 30 min.

pmc-12860148.title: Developmental pathways from authoritative mothering to early school-age externalizing problems: a longitudinal chain mediation model from preschool involving effortful control and negative emotion regulation
pmc-12860148.creator: Ni Zhang, Jinyun Chen, Xin Guo, Guziyi Xu, Jia Liu
pmc-12860148.description: BackgroundExternalizing problem behaviors (EPB) in children have an impact on their future tendencies towards criminal and violent behaviors. Maternal attitudes and behaviors are of great significance in the development of children’s temperament and emotion regulation strategies, which in turn affect children’s behavioral manifestations.

pmc-13110071.title: Undiagnosed Maternal Myotonic Dystrophy Type 1 Revealed by Congenital Myotonic Dystrophy in the Neonate
pmc-13110071.creator: Riku Suzui, Ikumi Wada, Motonori Matsubara, Dai Kataoka
pmc-13110071.description: Polyhydramnios and fetal morphological anomalies, such as micrognathia and clubfoot, are findings that often suggest fetal hereditary syndromes. However, these findings may also be associated with undiagnosed neuromuscular disorders in the mother, particularly myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1). Maternal hypogammaglobulinemia and neonatal findings in prior pregnancies may represent overlooked diagnostic clues.

pmc-13500944.title: Change in Vocal Resonance Following Sinonasal Surgery
pmc-13500944.creator: Meha G Fox, Sarah L Blumhardt, Lauren McCray, K Kelly Gallagher, Julina Ongkasuwan, Tran B Locke
pmc-13500944.description: ObjectivesDelineate objective and clinician‐perceived subjective changes in voice quality following sinonasal surgery.MethodsProspective cohort study of six adults who completed pre‐ and post‐operative voice recordings which were analyzed for jitter, shimmer, noise to harmonic ratio (NHR), cepstral peak prominence (CPP), formant and anti‐formant changes. Consensus auditory‐perceptual evaluation of voice (CAPE‐V) assessment was completed by two independent reviewers.

uslaw-usc-t22-s290h7.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 7 (International Bureaus, Congresses, Etc.); Subchapter XXIII (United States African Development Foundation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Any authority provided by this subchapter involving the expenditure of funds (other than the funds made available pursuant to section 290h–8 of this title) shall be effective for a fiscal year only to such extent.
